toegepas.voor: Daar is geen prente van mense of diere in nie.
toegepas.na: Dit bevat geen prente van mense of diere nie.
toegepas.rede_vinder: The stranded 'in' (split 'daarin') is colloquial and clumsy; 'Dit bevat ... nie' is clear standard Afrikaans with the same meaning.
toegepas.fout: The split 'daar ... in' makes 'daar' do double duty and leaves a stranded 'in' before 'nie', which can trip a reader.
toegepas.rede_keurder: 'Dit bevat geen ... nie' says the same thing plainly and matches the preceding 'Dit bestaan uit'.

laat_vaar.voor: Die koeie het melk gegee, en melk was 'n belangrike kos vir die Khoikhoi.
laat_vaar.na: Die Khoikhoi se koeie het melk gegee, en melk was vir hulle 'n belangrike kos.
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: The block opens with 'Die koeie' without an antecedent in the block; naming the owners first makes the reference clear without changing the claim.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: The same sentence already names the Khoikhoi and the previous block is about their herds, so the reference is clear; the proposal is a lateral reordering.

laat_vaar.na: Baie van die San se rotskuns wys
laat_vaar.rede_vinder: 'Baie' before the mass noun 'San-rotskuns' reads awkwardly; 'baie van die San se rotskuns' is the natural form and keeps the quantifier.
laat_vaar.rede_keurder: 'Baie' with a mass noun such as 'San-rotskuns' is normal Afrikaans; the proposal is longer and only reads differently.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Op soek na gras en water
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Temporal 'after' is written 'ná' to separate it from directional 'na'.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: The accent on temporal 'ná' is only needed where 'na' could be misread, and 'Na 'n ruk' is unambiguous.

laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Die Khoikhoi het ook nog gejag
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Die Khoikhoi het nog steeds gejag
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: Avoids a second 'ook' straight after 'Die diere het ook vleis gegee'; meaning is unchanged.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'Ook nog' means 'in addition to their livestock', while 'nog steeds' shifts it to 'continued over time', so the meaning narrows.
